headline: Cybersecurity Incident at Xiamen Rubber with No Impact on Production
body: Xiamen Zhengxin Rubber Industry Co., Ltd. recently experienced a cyber intrusion that compromised internal documents. The company reassured stakeholders that operations remain unaffected, and production continues as usual, with no delays in deliveries. Elsewhere, both Thai Steel Cable Public Co., Ltd.'s principal manufacturing site and Mitsuba Corporation's network have faced similar security challenges. Despite these incidents, the companies confirmed their production schedules are maintained without disruption.
